name: Loaded script list (javascripts)
plain: Lists which scripts the page loaded.
meaning: A list of script URLs (up to 2,200 chars) can reveal injected scripts from extensions or tools.

limits.headline: Can list the scripts loaded on its own page
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads or when a tool scans the page.
can: Find which scripts its page loaded, including ones from other companies
Spot tracking or ad scripts on its own page
Check that a script loaded as expected
cannot: See scripts on other sites or in other tabs
See what the scripts do inside other pages
See your browser add ons unless they change the page
Keep a list of what you visited before

story.what_it_is: A site can see which scripts are loaded in the page, which can reveal extensions.
story.for_you: You never see it. A page can tell if some extensions or tools have added their own scripts to it, which says something about how you browse.
story.for_makers: Fraud and security tools use it to spot injected code, bots and shady extensions. It also adds to a device profile used for tracking.

use_cases.example: A bank page spots an injected script from malware that tries to steal logins.
An ad network spots scripts from blockers and tracks how many viewers use them.
A checkout page flags a card skimmer script that was added by an attacker.
An anti cheat page spots cheat helper scripts running in a browser game.
A tag manager audits which scripts load, to remove slow or unauthorized ones.
A developer checks that third party scripts are the ones they approved.
